headline_item.title_zh: 人类研究表明，在工作中采用人工智能最困难的部分与学习工具无关
headline_item.title_en: Anthropic study shows the hardest part of adopting AI at work has little to do with learning the tools
headline_item.author: Matthias Bastian
headline_item.event_summary_zh: 一份新的 Anthropic 报告发现，人工智能模型不断变得更好，但将它们投入使用大多会产生摩擦。审查瓶颈、员工抵制、安全风险和过时的自定义工具正在拖累许多企业项目。 Anthropic 的研究人员对 58 家美国公司进行了 66 次面对面访谈
headline_item.event_summary_en:
AI models keep getting better, but putting them to work mostly creates friction, a new Anthropic report finds. Review bottlenecks, employee pushback, security risks, and outdated custom tools are dragging down many enterprise projects.
